title: Grade 6 Math — Mon, Jun 16
description: Triangles — Day 1 of 5: Types of triangles by sides
subject: mathematics

questions.question: An equilateral triangle has ___ equal sides.
questions.explanation: An equilateral triangle has all three sides equal in length.

questions.question: A triangle with exactly two equal sides is called ___.
questions.explanation: An isosceles triangle has exactly two equal sides.

questions.question: A scalene triangle has ___.
questions.explanation: A scalene triangle has all three sides of different lengths — no two sides are equal.

questions.question: A triangle with sides 5 cm, 5 cm, 5 cm is ___.
questions.explanation: All three sides are equal → equilateral triangle.

questions.question: A triangle with sides 3 cm, 3 cm, 5 cm is ___.
questions.explanation: Two sides are equal (3 cm, 3 cm) → isosceles triangle.

questions.question: A triangle with sides 4 cm, 6 cm, 9 cm is ___.
questions.explanation: All three sides are different (4, 6, 9) → scalene triangle.

questions.question: All angles of an equilateral triangle are equal to ___.
questions.explanation: In an equilateral triangle all three angles are equal. Since they must sum to 180°, each angle = 60°.

questions.question: The base angles of an isosceles triangle are ___.
questions.explanation: In an isosceles triangle the two angles opposite the equal sides (base angles) are always equal.

questions.question: Which statement is TRUE about a scalene triangle?
options: It has at least two equal sides
questions.explanation: A scalene triangle has all sides of different lengths — no two sides are equal.

questions.question: How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle have?
questions.explanation: An equilateral triangle has 3 lines of symmetry — one from each vertex to the midpoint of the opposite side.

questions.question: An isosceles triangle has ___ line(s) of symmetry.
questions.explanation: An isosceles triangle has exactly 1 line of symmetry — the perpendicular from the apex to the base.

questions.question: Which triangle has NO lines of symmetry?
questions.explanation: A scalene triangle has all sides different and no equal angles, so it has no lines of symmetry.

questions.question: A triangle has sides 5 cm, 12 cm, 13 cm. What type is it by sides?
questions.explanation: All three sides are different (5, 12, 13) → scalene triangle.

questions.question: Ravi draws a triangle with sides 6 cm, 6 cm, and 8 cm. What type is it?
questions.explanation: Two sides are equal (6 cm, 6 cm) → isosceles triangle.

questions.question: Which classification is correct for a triangle with sides 7 cm, 7 cm, 7 cm?
questions.explanation: All sides equal → equilateral. An equilateral triangle is also technically isosceles (it has at least two equal sides).
